contentSections.heading: The Shape of Great Sleep
contentSections.text: The Shape of Great Sleep Experience Unprecedented Comfort with BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam Personalized Comfort: Sleepyhead's BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam Technology adjusts to your body's unique contours for tailored comfort. Orthopedic Support: Designed with in-built intelligence, it offers orthopedic support customized to your weight and sleep position. Refreshingly Deep Sleep: The result? A deeply restorative slumber that recharges your body and mind. Elevated Comfort: Say goodbye to one-size-fits-all mattresses; say hello to the future of personalized sleep. Multi-layered Support Our revolutionary mattress offers a multi-layered support system that guarantees a heavenly slumber. With three layers meticulously designed to cater to your needs, it's the ultimate blend of support and comfort that suits everyone. The first layer is crafted with soft foam . It provides a gentle cradle, offering initial plushness while maintaining proper alignment for your spine. The second layer boasts BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam , which moulds to the contours of your body, providing personalised support where you need it most. It adapts to your unique shape, relieving pressure points and promoting proper spinal alignment. Completing the trifecta is the high-resilient foam layer . It offers exceptional durability and robust support, ensuring long-lasting comfort and preventing any sinking sensation Keep Calm and Sleep Steady Say goodbye to sleep disturbances caused by your partner's tossing and turning! Our mattress features an exceptional quality known as zero motion transfer, made possible by the remarkable properties of memory foam. The magic lies in memory foam's ability to isolate and absorb any movement that occurs on the mattress surface. When your partner shifts positions or gets out of bed, the memory foam works like a silent superhero, diligently absorbing those movements. As a result, you experience minimal to zero motion transfer, ensuring an uninterrupted slumber. By minimising motion transfer, we prioritise your sleep quality and enhance your overall sleep experience. So, whether you're a light sleeper or simply cherish uninterrupted sleep, you wake up refreshed, rejuvenated, and undisturbed.

contentSections.heading: FAQs
contentSections.text: FAQs What is the Original – 3 Layered BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress? Original is a medium firm mattress featuring Sleepyhead’s BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam technology. It contours to your body shape, weight, and sleep position to provide personalized support throughout the night. What problem does the Original mattress solve? It helps relieve pressure points and ensures proper spinal alignment by adapting to your body. It also minimizes partner disturbance with zero motion transfer for uninterrupted sleep. Who is the Original mattress best suited for? It is ideal for people looking for orthopedic support with a medium firm feel, those needing pressure relief and spinal alignment, and couples who want minimal motion transfer. How does the Original mattress work? It uses a three-layer system: a soft foam top layer for comfort, a BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam layer that adapts to your body and relieves pressure, and a high-resilient foam base for strong support and durability. How is the Original mattress different from other mattresses? Unlike standard mattresses, it uses BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam to adjust to your unique body profile, offering personalized support along with a multi-layer design and zero motion transfer. How does the Original mattress feel? It has a medium firm feel with a balance of plush comfort on top and strong underlying support for stability and proper alignment. Does the Original mattress come with a warranty or trial? Yes, it comes with a 10-year warranty and a 100-night free trial. How should I care for the Original mattress? Use a mattress protector, place it on a flat and supportive base, rotate it periodically if recommended, and avoid folding or standing on it.
